errorTargetNote: errorTarget is a SCORING aid only: a narrow case-insensitive pattern that finds the extracted assertion(s) stating this specific error in an audit output. It can recognize these known cases; it cannot enforce a general identity policy over arbitrary prose, and it is never a publication gate. 'availableEvidence' names evidence that was supplied to the auditor and should have been used.
